canonical_authority_model.purpose: Capture where a fact came from and preserve origin, privacy, freshness, exact reference, digest or future integrity reference, limitations, and review status.
Represent normalized career facts and point to one or more evidence sources.
Connect a fact to source evidence and preserve excerpts, support strength, limitation, and support classification.
Represent resume bullets, application answers, portfolio copy, interview narratives, or AI recommendations as downstream presentation.
Promote, reject, correct, supersede, or limit a fact under Ross or governed review.

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Verified source or Ross-confirmed fact with limitation
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Invent titles, dates, employer names, or outcomes

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Diploma, transcript, resume source, or Ross confirmation
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Convert coursework into degree completion without source

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Certificate, issuer record, or Ross confirmation
Project, employment, education, or certification evidence
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Infer proficiency or years from keywords

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Work artifact, project, employment, or certification source
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Treat package presence as personal expertise by itself

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Repository, artifact, proof, or operator-confirmed source
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Claim client results or commercial outcomes without proof
Treat product existence as personal achievement
Claim production impact unless proof exists

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Deck, invite, recording, or operator confirmation
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Claim audience, employer, or publication status without source
Inflate metrics, revenue, customer impact, or scope

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: Project or employment evidence or operator confirmation
entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Convert solo work into people-management claim without source

entity_authority_requirements.minimum_authority: URL, document, publisher, or operator confirmation

entity_authority_requirements.must_not: Let resume wording become primary authority
